docs.description: This individual participation hackathon is a platform for designers, engineers, students, and innovators to bring their creative 3D-printable product ideas to life. Participants will have the opportunity to design, develop, and showcase functional and industry-relevant 3D models while pushing the boundaries of innovation, usability, and design feasibility
docs.event: Design Your Dream - Be Your Own Entrepreneur Hackathon for 3D Product Design

data.title: Mr E.Elanchezhian
data.details: I am Elanchezhian.E, a passionate mechanical engineering student studying at Loyola ICAM College of Engineering and Technology. I am very much interested in design and simulation field having designed for many competitions and products which includes Model rockets to Mobile phone screen projectors. I thank Stacia Corp for organizing this competition which enabled me to upgrade my Designing skills
